name: Moraga Police Cadets
what_you_do: Explore police work as a community service cadet. You see how the police department works. You learn about local government, and you join some department training.
who_can_apply: U.S. citizens ages 16 to 22 who are in high school or college with a 2.5 GPA or better. You need a valid California driver license and a good driving record. You must pass an oral board and a background check. You must volunteer at least 4 hours a week.
pay_detail: Community service role. You volunteer at least 4 hours a week.
deadline_text: No application dates are stated on the employment page.
how_to_apply: Contact Lt. Steve Borbely at 925-888-7052 to ask about the Police Cadet Program and how to apply.
notes: The cadet program is on the town employment page, below the police officer and reserve officer jobs. Good character and good health are also on the list. Ask the department if it is taking cadets now.
